messages:
elsa (Docs): quick flag — /webhook/callback API ref example has metadata as an array but the service returns an object. TS snippet blowing up in console.

sam (API): ugh, thanks for catching. where exactly is the example? link?

elsa (Docs): in the openapi examples section: https://redwood.dev/api-ref#/webhook/callback — near the `response` example. shows `metadata: []` but real payload looks like `metadata: { requestId: '...', source: 'ingest' }`.

mohit (SDK): that would explain the TS compile error I saw in the docs sample — our SDK type expects `Record<string,string>` but the example array made it `string[]`.

sam (API): hmm, looks like someone copy/pasted the old batch example. runtime returned object consistently for >2 months. my bad.

lucas (PM): impact? customer reported parser crash?

elsa (Docs): internal QA hit it when switching the TS quickstart to the webhook flow. Not a production outage but the sample code `const meta = resp.metadata[0]` is wrong.

mohit (SDK): small CSV of problems: docs snippet uses `metadata[0]`, SDK type in `types.ts` is `string[] | null`, and example in JS demo does `Array.isArray` guard. We should canonicalize to object.

sam (API): agreed — API surface uses object (keyed metadata) across other endpoints. I'll check server logs to confirm no endpoints send array.

sam (API): quick check done — only the docs example is wrong. all server responses are objects indexed by key.

elsa (Docs): propose: change openapi example to `metadata: { requestId: "abc123", source: "ingest" }`, update TS/JS snippets in the same docs page, and add a tiny migration note: "previous docs showed metadata as array; runtime returns object".

mohit (SDK): i'll change the SDK types and a unit test to assert object shape, and patch the example snippet in the SDK quickstart. PR on my side: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/182

elsa (Docs): i'll open a docs PR for the API ref and quickstart. will also add an explicit example of accessing `metadata.requestId`.

elsa (Docs): draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/420 — includes updated openapi example, TS snippet replacement, and a short note in the changelog.

sam (API): can you also add a runtime assertion in the API to normalize `metadata` (if someone ever returns an array by mistake)? e.g. coerce arrays to an object using first item keys. defensive but cheap.

mohit (SDK): SGTM. i'll make the SDK tolerant too: accept `Record<string, string> | Array<Record<string,string>>` and normalize to object in client. no breaking change.

elsa (Docs): PR ready for review. would appreciate an approval from API + SDK.

lucas (PM): timeline? we'd like this in docs deploy tomorrow morning if possible.

elsa (Docs): aiming for a docs deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT. SDK PR already opened. API change is just a defensive middleware if sam wants it, but not required to fix docs.

sam (API): i can add the middleware today, will link PR soon.

sam (API): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/api/pull/999 — small middleware to coerce `metadata` to object if it's an array. Includes unit test.

mohit (SDK): merged my PR to main. published canary 0.12.3-canary.5 with type tolerance.

docbot: docs deploy queued by elsa at 2026-03-23T18:05:00Z :rocket:

elsa (Docs): merged docs PR and updated the quickstart snippet. verified examples render properly in storybook.

docbot: docs deploy successful (v2026-03-23-1645) :white_check_mark: — live in staging.

lucas (PM): nice! please add a quick blurb in the release notes about the example fix so support can reference it.

elsa (Docs): added release note in the changelog entry. tagging #support and #customer-success with the link.

sam (API): thanks everyone. follow-up: i'll update the internal API spec generator to stop emitting the old array example.

elsa (Docs): closing the loop — i'll keep the thread updated if any other snippet mismatches pop up. :tada:
